positive.why: то же через кортеж и IN, с DISTINCT
positive.sql: SELECT DISTINCT order_date AS action_date, person_id FROM person_order WHERE (order_date, person_id) IN (SELECT visit_date, person_id FROM person_visits) ORDER BY action_date ASC, person_id DESC;

negative.why: UNION вместо INTERSECT: попали все пары, а не общие
negative.sql: SELECT order_date AS action_date, person_id FROM person_order UNION SELECT visit_date, person_id FROM person_visits ORDER BY action_date ASC, person_id DESC;

SELECT order_date AS action_date, person_id FROM person_order
INTERSECT
SELECT visit_date, person_id FROM person_visits
ORDER BY action_date ASC, person_id ASC;

negative.why: столбец с датой не переименован в action_date
negative.sql: SELECT order_date, person_id FROM person_order INTERSECT SELECT visit_date, person_id FROM person_visits ORDER BY order_date ASC, person_id DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT order_date AS action_date, person_order.person_id FROM person_order JOIN person_visits ON person_visits.person_id = person_order.person_id AND person_visits.visit_date = person_order.order_date ORDER BY action_date ASC, person_id DESC;
